featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kirti book depot is nostalgia for me. It has always been there and it will always remain there. In my school days I would rush here to buy Hero fountain pens and chart papers and crayons. Now my son pulls me there to buy pens, books, stationery, gifts etc. The same old happy, smiling staff members, the same warmth, the same smell of a pure book depot and the love of meeting the old memories everytime I visit.

This is landmark, this is memory, this is Kirti book depot.
